usedFor: Acadle holds your learners, and Sangam CRM receives each “New User” as a sales opportunity through “Create Opportunity”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in Acadle, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Each new learner enters the sales pipeline with a next follow-up date, so someone reaches out.

watchOut: “New User” in Acadle is polling, so “Create Opportunity” runs after a scheduled check, not at sign-up.
